question: The book 'Indian Parliamentary Diplomacy - Speaker's Perspective' is authored by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meira Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Parliamentary Diplomacy**__

 __
 
• **Former Lok Sabha speaker Meira Kumar is the author of "Indian Parliamentary Diplomacy- Speaker's Perspective".**
 
• **The book features an account of parliamentary diplomacy and its role in furthering foreign policy and strengthening international relations**.
 
• It is also a collection of select speeches and reports by Kumar during her stint as Lok Sabha speaker and as leader of Indian parliamentary delegations at several international fora. 
 
 
 
• **Meira Kumar**__
 __
 
• **Meira Kumar is an Indian politician(INC) and former diplomat.**
 
• She was the mInister of **Social Justice and Empowerment from 2004 to 2009 **and she was the 15th Speaker of Lok Sabha from 2009 to 2014.
 
• She became just the second woman to be nominated for president of India by a major political bloc when she secured the United Progressive Alliance's nomination in 2017.
 
• She was also a **5-time Member of Parliament.**
 
• Her book entitled "Indian Parliamentary Diplomacy-Speaker's Perspective" was released on 19 March 2015.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Om Birla**__

 __
 
• **Om Birla is an Indian politician**.
 
• He is the 17th and **current speaker of the Lok Sabha.**
 
• He belongs to the Bhartiya Janata Party.
 
• He serves as a Member of Parliament for the Kota-Bundi constituency in Rajasthan.
 
• He was elected thrice to the assembly of Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• **Balram Jhakar**__
 __
 
• **Balram Jakhar was an Indian politician.**
 
• He served as the Speaker of the Lok Sabha and Governor of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• He was also the longest-serving Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Shivraj Patil**__
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who was the Minister of Home Affairs of India, from 2004 to 2008 and the 10th Speaker of the Lok Sabha from 1991 to 1996.**
 
• He was Governor of the state of **Punjab and Administrator of the Union Territory of Chandigarh from 2010 to 2015**.
 
• He was served in the Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi cabinets as Minister of Defence during the 1980s.
